Title: Plaintext Password Hash Comparison & Static Mock JWT
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Submit POST /auth/login with password. 2. Observe controller string comparison. 3. Observe issued token.
Expected Behavior: Passwords verified with bcrypt/argon2; signed JWT with expiry and claims issued.
Actual Behavior: Checks password !== user.passwordHash with string inequality; returns static string 'jwt_token_mock_until_nestjs_auth_guard_is_setup'.
Recommended Fix: Implement bcrypt.compare() and JwtService.sign() with RS256/HS256 and expiration.

Title: Unauthenticated Public Exposure of Agent PII Directory
Steps to Reproduce: Execute curl -X GET http://localhost:4000/api/v1/agents without Authorization header.
Expected Behavior: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for anonymous caller.
Actual Behavior: HTTP 200 OK returning full agent PII (Names, phone numbers, residential addresses, cities, state, postal codes).
Recommended Fix: Enforce JwtAuthGuard on /api/v1/agents and validate Bearer token claims.

Title: IDOR and Unauthenticated Audio Access on Telephony Recordings
Steps to Reproduce: Execute GET /telephony/calls/:callId/recording with arbitrary callId without token.
Expected Behavior: HTTP 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.
Actual Behavior: Endpoint has no @UseGuards() check; allows arbitrary call ID probing without auth.
Recommended Fix: Apply @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) and verify caller tenant/ownership.

Title: Plaintext Cloud Infrastructure Secrets Committed in Repository
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect CRM/Backend/.env file.
Expected Behavior: Secrets stored in secret manager / environment variables; excluded via .gitignore.
Actual Behavior: Plaintext Supabase Service Role key, Redis cloud password, Twilio SID/token, LiveKit secret, Vobiz token, Gmail SMTP password committed.
Recommended Fix: Immediately revoke/rotate all 6 credentials; gitignore .env; use cloud secret manager.

Title: Lead API Route Prefix Discrepancy (Frontend /leads 404 vs Backend /api/v1/leads)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open frontend /leads or /agent/leads. 2. Frontend store calls GET /leads.
Expected Behavior: Frontend fetches and displays leads from backend.
Actual Behavior: GET /leads returns HTTP 404; store silently fails or displays empty state.
Recommended Fix: Update useLeadStore.ts to use /api/v1/leads or add alias redirect in backend.

Title: Dashboard Analytics 404 Masked by Hardcoded Fallback Data
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /admin/dashboard. 2. Observe network request to /dashboard/analytics.
Expected Behavior: Dashboard displays real aggregated database KPIs.
Actual Behavior: API returns HTTP 404; store silently masks failure with hardcoded mock numbers (14, 3, 04:22, 94%).
Recommended Fix: Implement /dashboard/analytics backend route with real Prisma aggregation; remove mocks.

Title: Appointments Calendar Route Mismatch (404)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open /calendar or /appointments. 2. Observe request to /calendar or /api/v1/appointments/calendar.
Expected Behavior: Calendar displays booked appointments from database.
Actual Behavior: Both frontend routes return HTTP 404; backend endpoint is /appointments/calendar.
Recommended Fix: Harmonize route naming across Frontend and Backend to /api/v1/appointments/calendar.

Title: API Gateway Health Endpoint Returns 404
Steps to Reproduce: Execute GET http://localhost:4000/api/v1/health.
Expected Behavior: HTTP 200 Gateway Health Status OK.
Actual Behavior: HTTP 404 Cannot GET /api/v1/health because ApiGatewayModule is an empty @Module({}).
Recommended Fix: Register ApiGatewayController in controllers array of ApiGatewayModule.

Title: Vobiz Inbound Webhook Returns Raw String 'OK' with text/xml Header
Steps to Reproduce: Send POST /vobiz/incoming with valid carrier call payload.
Expected Behavior: Backend responds with valid carrier XML syntax (<Response><Dial><Sip>...).
Actual Behavior: Responds with raw string 'OK' and Header 'Content-Type: text/xml', which is invalid XML for carriers.
Recommended Fix: Generate well-formed XML dial instructions for carrier SIP bridge.

Title: Dead Placeholder Modules & Static Mock Forms with Unwired Buttons
Steps to Reproduce: Click interactive buttons on /marketing, /automation, /targets, /settings.
Expected Behavior: Triggers backend CRUD mutations; persists state.
Actual Behavior: Buttons do nothing or update local React mock state; zero backend API integration.
Recommended Fix: Connect forms and buttons to corresponding backend API endpoints.

Title: Static 22-line Placeholder Stubs for Care Plans, Emergency Alerts & Feedback
Steps to Reproduce: Navigate to /care-plans, /emergency-alerts, /feedback.
Expected Behavior: Operational modules with data entry and alert triggers.
Actual Behavior: Renders 22-line static placeholder cards without backend endpoints or models.
Recommended Fix: Implement schema models and backend controllers for care workflows.

Title: Prisma Schema Drift in Legacy Call Service (User.organizationId Missing)
Steps to Reproduce: Start CRM/Backend-call service and invoke database query.
Expected Behavior: Legacy call service queries database without schema errors.
Actual Behavior: Throws PrismaClientKnownRequestError: P2022: Column User.organizationId does not exist.
Recommended Fix: Run prisma migrate deploy to align legacy Prisma schema with primary DB.

Title: Client-side Simulation of Omnichannel Message Dispatch
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open omnichannel chat. 2. Send WhatsApp message. 3. Inspect network tab.
Expected Behavior: Dispatches message to WhatsApp Business API via backend webhook.
Actual Behavior: Simulates delivery via client-side setTimeout; no outbound API call is dispatched.
Recommended Fix: Build backend WhatsApp provider integration via Meta Graph API / Twilio WhatsApp.

Title: Ticket Table Column Rendering Failure Due to Key Name Mismatch
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /tickets. 2. Observe table columns for Customer and Subject.
Expected Behavior: Table renders customer names and subject titles.
Actual Behavior: Columns render blank values because JSX looks for item.customer, item.subject while mock provides customerName, title.
Recommended Fix: Align property names in Ticket interface and table mapping.

Title: AI Post-Call Pipeline Calls Non-Existent Model (gemini-3.8-flash)
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect ai-summary.service.ts model configuration.
Expected Behavior: Initializes valid Google Gemini model (e.g. gemini-1.5-flash).
Actual Behavior: Configured with non-existent model name 'gemini-3.8-flash' and malformed key format.
Recommended Fix: Update model name to gemini-1.5-flash and supply valid Google AI Studio key.

Title: Cloud Redis Network Timeout Induces 2000ms Latency on Agent Queries
Steps to Reproduce: Execute GET /api/v1/agents and inspect server logs.
Expected Behavior: Presence fetched in <50ms from local cache.
Actual Behavior: Remote redislabs.com:12592 connection times out; hardcoded 2000ms timeout blocks HTTP response.
Recommended Fix: Deploy co-located Redis container; reduce timeout to 150ms with database fallback.

Title: Absence of Enterprise HTTP Security Headers (CSP, XFO, HSTS, XCTO)
Steps to Reproduce: Execute curl -I http://localhost:4000/ and inspect headers.
Expected Behavior: Headers include Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options.
Actual Behavior: All 4 enterprise security headers are absent from HTTP responses.
Recommended Fix: Install and configure helmet middleware in main.ts: app.use(helmet()).

Title: Lack of Rate Limiting & Brute-Force Defenses on Public API Endpoints
Steps to Reproduce: Send 10 rapid concurrent HTTP requests to root and auth endpoints.
Expected Behavior: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests returned after threshold.
Actual Behavior: All requests accepted without throttling; no ThrottlerModule configured in AppModule.
Recommended Fix: Configure @nestjs/throttler ThrottlerModule globally.

Title: WCAG 4.1.2 Violation: 6 Icon-Only Buttons Missing Accessible Name
Steps to Reproduce: Run accessibility scan on frontend TSX components.
Expected Behavior: Icon-only buttons have aria-label or accessible text.
Actual Behavior: 6 icon-only buttons in ConversationSidebar, OmnichannelApp, automation have no aria-label.
Recommended Fix: Add descriptive aria-label to all icon-only buttons.

Title: WCAG 1.3.1 Violation: 90 Form Inputs Unassociated with Programmatic Labels
Steps to Reproduce: Run accessibility scan on frontend TSX components.
Expected Behavior: All form inputs have associated <label htmlFor> or aria-label.
Actual Behavior: 90 inputs across 134 components lack labels, IDs, or aria-labels.
Recommended Fix: Add <label htmlFor='id'> or aria-label to all 90 inputs.

Title: WCAG 1.1.1 Violation: 6 Informative Images Missing alt Attributes
Steps to Reproduce: Run accessibility scan on frontend TSX components.
Expected Behavior: All tags have alt attributes.
Actual Behavior: 6 tags in components lack alt attributes.
Recommended Fix: Add descriptive alt text to informative images and alt='' to decorative ones.

Title: Supabase PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion under 25 Concurrent VUs
Steps to Reproduce: Run load test at 25 concurrent users against /api/v1/leads.
Expected Behavior: Prisma handles concurrent queries cleanly or queues them safely.
Actual Behavior: Throws FATAL: (EMAXCONNSESSION) max clients reached in session mode - pool_size: 15; returns HTTP 500 (2.00% error rate).
Root-Cause Status: CONFIRMED in server logs & load test
Recommended Fix: Switch Supabase to Transaction pooler (port 6543) and increase pool_size in connection string.
